spectral-finite-sections.title: A. C. Hansen, On the approximation of spectra of linear Hilbert space operators, PhD thesis
spectral-finite-sections.scope: Classical finite-section shift example shows that finite model spectra can fail to recover the limit spectrum. The c0 model with eventual exact norms of every polynomial and all proofs here are independently constructed.
support_locations: Official preprint Infinite Dimensional Numerical Linear Algebra: Theory and Applications, page 3
spectral-finite-sections.retrieval_note: Primary-source search extracts expose the cited finite-section passage; direct PDF fetch of thesis exceeded browser size limit. Author and thesis title verified on https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/research/afha/anders/.
spectral-finite-sections.reuse: Public background only; no copied exercise or source proof text. No unpublished OET material.
